# Check reference

Every check the scanner runs, grouped by platform and category. "Needs root" means the check reports ERROR unless the scanner runs as root on Linux or as an administrator on Windows.

## Linux (41 checks)

Benchmark family: CIS Benchmarks for Ubuntu Linux. Written against: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (also exercised on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS).

### Filesystem

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-FS-001 | Ensure mounting of cramfs filesystems is disabled | high | no | yes | The cramfs kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded | Create /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf containing "install cramfs /bin/false" and "blacklist cramfs", then run "modprobe -r cramfs". |
| LNX-FS-002 | Ensure mounting of squashfs filesystems is disabled | medium | no | yes | The squashfs kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded | Create /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf containing "install squashfs /bin/false" and "blacklist squashfs". Do not apply this on hosts that use snap packages. |
| LNX-FS-003 | Ensure mounting of udf filesystems is disabled | low | no | yes | The udf kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded | Create /etc/modprobe.d/udf.conf containing "install udf /bin/false" and "blacklist udf", then run "modprobe -r udf". |
| LNX-FS-004 | Ensure /tmp is a separate partition | high | no | yes | /tmp is its own mount point | Mount /tmp as its own file system, for example with the systemd tmp.mount unit or an /etc/fstab entry. |
| LNX-FS-005 | Ensure noexec option set on /tmp partition | high | no | yes | /tmp is mounted with the noexec option | Add noexec to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount. |
| LNX-FS-006 | Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition | medium | no | yes | /tmp is mounted with the nodev option | Add nodev to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount. |
| LNX-FS-007 | Ensure nosuid option set on /tmp partition | medium | no | yes | /tmp is mounted with the nosuid option | Add nosuid to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount. |

### Authentication

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-AUTH-001 | Ensure password expiration is 365 days or less | high | no | yes | PASS_MAX_DAYS in /etc/login.defs is between 1 and 365 | Set PASS_MAX_DAYS to 365 or less in /etc/login.defs and run "chage --maxdays 365 <user>" for existing accounts. |
| LNX-AUTH-002 | Ensure minimum days between password changes is configured | medium | no | yes | PASS_MIN_DAYS in /etc/login.defs is 1 or more | Set PASS_MIN_DAYS to 1 or more in /etc/login.defs and run "chage --mindays 1 <user>" for existing accounts. |
| LNX-AUTH-003 | Ensure password expiration warning days is 7 or more | low | no | yes | PASS_WARN_AGE in /etc/login.defs is 7 or more | Set PASS_WARN_AGE to 7 or more in /etc/login.defs. |
| LNX-AUTH-004 | Ensure inactive password lock is 30 days or less | medium | no | yes | The useradd default INACTIVE is between 0 and 30 days | Run "useradd -D -f 30" and "chage --inactive 30 <user>" for existing accounts. |
| LNX-AUTH-005 | Ensure root is the only UID 0 account | critical | no | yes | root is the only account with UID 0 in /etc/passwd | Remove every other UID 0 account or give it a unique non-zero UID. |
| LNX-AUTH-006 | Ensure root login is restricted to system console | high | no | yes | Where pam_securetty is in use, /etc/securetty exists and lists only approved consoles | Review /etc/securetty and remove every terminal that is not physically secured. |
| LNX-AUTH-007 | Ensure SSH root login is disabled | critical | yes | yes | The effective sshd setting PermitRootLogin is "no" | Set "PermitRootLogin no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd. |
| LNX-AUTH-008 | Ensure SSH PermitEmptyPasswords is disabled | critical | yes | yes | The effective sshd setting PermitEmptyPasswords is "no" | Set "PermitEmptyPasswords no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd. |
| LNX-AUTH-009 | Review SSH PasswordAuthentication against site policy | medium | yes | no | Password logins over SSH are either disabled or documented as an approved exception | Set "PasswordAuthentication no" and use keys or certificates, unless site policy documents a need for password logins. |
| LNX-AUTH-010 | Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is set to 4 or less | medium | yes | yes | The effective sshd setting MaxAuthTries is 4 or less | Set "MaxAuthTries 4" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd. |

### Network

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-NET-001 | Ensure IP forwarding is disabled | high | no | yes | net.ipv4.ip_forward and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding are 0 in the running kernel | Set net.ipv4.ip_forward=0 and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-002 | Ensure packet redirect sending is disabled | medium | no | yes | net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects and net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects are 0 | Set both send_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-003 | Ensure source routed packets are not accepted | medium | no | yes | accept_source_route is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled | Set the accept_source_route keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-004 | Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted | medium | no | yes | accept_redirects is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled | Set the accept_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-005 | Ensure broadcast ICMP requests are ignored | medium | no | yes | net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts is 1 | Set net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts=1 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-006 | Ensure TCP SYN Cookies is enabled | high | no | yes | net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies is 1 | Set net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=1 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system". |
| LNX-NET-007 | Ensure a host firewall is active | critical | yes | yes | ufw, firewalld, nftables or iptables is active with a filtering rule set | Enable one host firewall, for example "ufw enable" after allowing the services the host needs. |

### Logging

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-LOG-001 | Ensure rsyslog is installed | high | no | yes | The rsyslog package is installed | Install rsyslog with "apt install rsyslog". |
| LNX-LOG-002 | Ensure rsyslog service is enabled | high | no | yes | The rsyslog unit is enabled | Run "systemctl --now enable rsyslog". |
| LNX-LOG-003 | Ensure journald is configured to compress large log files | low | no | yes | Compress=yes is set in the journald configuration | Set Compress=yes in /etc/systemd/journald.conf or a drop-in under /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d and restart systemd-journald. |
| LNX-LOG-004 | Ensure journald is configured to write logfiles to persistent disk | medium | no | yes | Storage=persistent is set in the journald configuration | Set Storage=persistent in /etc/systemd/journald.conf or a drop-in under /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d and restart systemd-journald. |
| LNX-LOG-005 | Ensure permissions on /var/log are configured | medium | no | no | /var/log is owned by root with group root, adm or syslog and is not writable by others | Run "chown root /var/log" and "chmod o-w /var/log". |

### Access control

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-ACC-001 | Ensure permissions on /etc/passwd are configured | high | no | yes | /etc/passwd is owned by root:root with mode 0644 or more restrictive | Run "chown root:root /etc/passwd" and "chmod u-x,go-wx /etc/passwd". |
| LNX-ACC-002 | Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow are configured | critical | no | yes | /etc/shadow is owned by root, group root or shadow, with mode 0640 or more restrictive | Run "chown root:shadow /etc/shadow" and "chmod u-x,g-wx,o-rwx /etc/shadow". |
| LNX-ACC-003 | Ensure permissions on /etc/group are configured | high | no | yes | /etc/group is owned by root:root with mode 0644 or more restrictive | Run "chown root:root /etc/group" and "chmod u-x,go-wx /etc/group". |
| LNX-ACC-004 | Ensure no world writable files exist | high | yes | yes | No regular file on a local file system is writable by "other" | Review each file and run "chmod o-w <file>" where world write access is not required. |
| LNX-ACC-005 | Ensure no unowned or ungrouped files or directories exist | medium | yes | yes | Every file and directory on a local file system has a known owner and group | Assign each file to a valid account with "chown <user>:<group> <path>" or remove it. |
| LNX-ACC-006 | Review SUID and SGID executables | high | yes | yes | Every SUID or SGID executable is known and justified | Compare the list with your approved baseline and remove the bit with "chmod u-s,g-s <file>" where it is not needed. |

### Services

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LNX-SVC-001 | Ensure xinetd is not installed | medium | no | yes | The xinetd package is not installed | Remove it with "apt purge xinetd". |
| LNX-SVC-002 | Ensure telnet server is not installed | critical | no | yes | No telnet server package is installed | Remove it with "apt purge telnetd inetutils-telnetd" and use SSH. |
| LNX-SVC-003 | Ensure FTP server is not installed | high | no | yes | No FTP server package is installed | Remove it with "apt purge vsftpd" and use SFTP. |
| LNX-SVC-004 | Ensure HTTP server is not installed unless required | medium | no | yes | No web server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one | Remove the web server if this host does not need one, for example "apt purge apache2 nginx". |
| LNX-SVC-005 | Ensure LDAP server is not installed unless required | medium | no | yes | No LDAP server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one | Remove slapd if this host is not a directory server, with "apt purge slapd". |
| LNX-SVC-006 | Ensure NFS is not installed unless required | medium | no | yes | No NFS server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one | Remove the NFS server if this host does not export file systems, with "apt purge nfs-kernel-server". |

## Windows (32 checks)

Benchmark family: CIS Benchmarks for Microsoft Windows Server. Written against: Windows Server 2019 and 2022, member server profile.

### Filesystem

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-FS-001 | Ensure fixed volumes use NTFS or ReFS | high | no | no | Every fixed volume with a drive letter is formatted NTFS or ReFS | Convert the volume with "convert <drive>: /fs:ntfs" or reformat it. |
| WIN-FS-002 | Ensure the registry hive folder grants no write access to broad groups | high | yes | no | Everyone, Users and Authenticated Users hold no write, modify or full control entry on %SystemRoot%\System32\config | Remove the broad write entry with icacls and restore the default ACL for the folder. |

### Authentication

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-AUTH-001 | Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to 24 or more passwords | high | yes | yes | PasswordHistorySize is 24 or more | Set "Enforce password history" to 24 under Account Policies, Password Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-002 | Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to 365 or fewer days, but not 0 | high | yes | yes | MaximumPasswordAge is between 1 and 365 days | Set "Maximum password age" to 365 or fewer days under Account Policies, Password Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-003 | Ensure 'Minimum password age' is set to 1 or more days | medium | yes | yes | MinimumPasswordAge is 1 or more days | Set "Minimum password age" to 1 or more days under Account Policies, Password Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-004 | Ensure 'Minimum password length' is set to 14 or more characters | high | yes | yes | MinimumPasswordLength is 14 or more | Set "Minimum password length" to 14 under Account Policies, Password Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-005 | Ensure 'Password must meet complexity requirements' is set to Enabled | high | yes | yes | PasswordComplexity is 1 | Enable "Password must meet complexity requirements" under Account Policies, Password Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-006 | Ensure 'Account lockout threshold' is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0 | high | yes | yes | LockoutBadCount is between 1 and 5 | Set "Account lockout threshold" to 5 or fewer under Account Policies, Account Lockout Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-007 | Ensure 'Account lockout duration' is set to 15 or more minutes | medium | yes | yes | LockoutDuration is 15 or more minutes. A lockout that lasts until an administrator clears it also passes | Set "Account lockout duration" to 15 or more minutes under Account Policies, Account Lockout Policy. |
| WIN-AUTH-008 | Ensure 'Accounts - Guest account status' is set to Disabled | critical | yes | yes | EnableGuestAccount is 0 | Disable the Guest account with "net user Guest /active:no" or the matching security option. |
| WIN-AUTH-009 | Configure 'Accounts - Rename administrator account' | medium | yes | yes | The built-in administrator account is not named "Administrator" | Rename the built-in account with the "Accounts: Rename administrator account" security option. |
| WIN-AUTH-010 | Ensure Remote Desktop requires Network Level Authentication | high | no | yes | UserAuthentication is 1 for the RDP-Tcp listener or in policy | Enable "Require user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication" in Remote Desktop Session Host security policy. |

### Network

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-NET-001 | Ensure Windows Firewall is on for the Domain, Private and Public profiles | critical | no | yes | All three firewall profiles are enabled | Run "Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Private,Public -Enabled True". |
| WIN-NET-002 | Ensure the SMB v1 server is disabled | critical | yes | yes | EnableSMB1Protocol is False in the SMB server configuration | Run "Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false -Force". |
| WIN-NET-003 | Ensure NetBIOS over TCP/IP is disabled on every IP-enabled adapter | medium | no | no | TcpipNetbiosOptions is 2 on every IP-enabled adapter | Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP in the adapter WINS settings or through DHCP option 001. |
| WIN-NET-004 | Ensure 'Turn off multicast name resolution' is set to Enabled | medium | no | yes | The policy value EnableMulticast is 0 | Enable "Turn off multicast name resolution" under Network, DNS Client in Group Policy. |
| WIN-NET-005 | Ensure the WinRM service does not allow unencrypted traffic | high | yes | yes | AllowUnencrypted is false for the WinRM service | Set "Allow unencrypted traffic" to Disabled under Windows Remote Management, WinRM Service in Group Policy. |

### Logging

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-LOG-001 | Ensure 'Audit Logon' is set to Success and Failure | high | yes | yes | The Logon subcategory audits Success and Failure | Run auditpol /set /subcategory:"Logon" /success:enable /failure:enable or set it in Advanced Audit Policy. |
| WIN-LOG-002 | Ensure 'Audit User Account Management' is set to Success and Failure | high | yes | yes | The User Account Management subcategory audits Success and Failure | Run auditpol /set /subcategory:"User Account Management" /success:enable /failure:enable or set it in Advanced Audit Policy. |
| WIN-LOG-003 | Ensure 'Audit Sensitive Privilege Use' is set to Success and Failure | medium | yes | yes | The Sensitive Privilege Use subcategory audits Success and Failure | Run auditpol /set /subcategory:"Sensitive Privilege Use" /success:enable /failure:enable or set it in Advanced Audit Policy. |
| WIN-LOG-004 | Ensure the Security event log maximum size is 196,608 KB or greater | medium | yes | yes | The Security log maximum size is at least 196,608 KB | Set "Specify the maximum log file size (KB)" to 196608 or more for the Security log in Group Policy. |
| WIN-LOG-005 | Ensure the Windows Event Log service is running | high | no | no | The EventLog service status is Running | Run "Start-Service EventLog" and set the service to start automatically. |

### Access control

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-ACC-001 | Ensure UAC runs all administrators in Admin Approval Mode | critical | no | yes | EnableLUA is 1 | Enable "User Account Control: Run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode" and restart. |
| WIN-ACC-002 | Ensure UAC prompts administrators for consent or credentials on the secure desktop | high | no | yes | ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin is 1 or 2 | Set the UAC administrator prompt behavior to "Prompt for consent on the secure desktop" in Security Options. |
| WIN-ACC-003 | Review membership of the local Administrators group | high | no | no | Every member of the local Administrators group is known and justified | Remove accounts that do not need administrator rights with "Remove-LocalGroupMember". |
| WIN-ACC-004 | Ensure anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts is not allowed | medium | no | yes | RestrictAnonymousSAM is 1 | Enable "Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts" in Security Options. |
| WIN-ACC-005 | Ensure no shares can be accessed anonymously | high | no | yes | NullSessionShares is empty or absent | Clear "Network access: Shares that can be accessed anonymously" in Security Options. |

### Services

| ID | Check | Severity | Needs root | CIS recommendation | Expected state | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WIN-SVC-001 | Ensure the Telnet server service is absent or disabled | critical | no | no | The TlntSvr service is not installed or its start type is Disabled | Run "Set-Service TlntSvr -StartupType Disabled" or remove the Telnet Server feature. |
| WIN-SVC-002 | Ensure the Microsoft FTP service is absent or disabled | high | no | no | The FTPSVC service is not installed or its start type is Disabled | Run "Set-Service FTPSVC -StartupType Disabled" or remove the FTP Server role service. |
| WIN-SVC-003 | Ensure Print Spooler is disabled on domain controllers | high | no | yes | On a domain controller the Spooler service start type is Disabled | Run "Stop-Service Spooler" and "Set-Service Spooler -StartupType Disabled" on every domain controller. |
| WIN-SVC-004 | Ensure the Remote Registry service is disabled | medium | no | no | The RemoteRegistry service is not installed or its start type is Disabled | Run "Set-Service RemoteRegistry -StartupType Disabled". |
| WIN-SVC-005 | Ensure the SNMP service is absent or disabled unless required | medium | no | no | The SNMP service is not installed or its start type is Disabled | Run "Set-Service SNMP -StartupType Disabled" or remove the SNMP feature if nothing depends on it. |
